title: EncFormer: Secure and Efficient Transformer Inference over Encrypted Data
description: Official self-contained implementation of EncFormer. The archive contains the GPU CKKS implementation, CKKS--MPC conversion, BPMax, MBNorm, BOLT GELU, real two-party EzPC/SCI execution, native dependency source, the BERT-base SST-2 checkpoint, local evaluation data, and evaluation commands.
